title: Luz: a C++20 Path Tracer developed from scratch with zero third-party dependencies
description:
If you love computer graphics, you have to see this. A developer spent over a year building a complete C plus plus path tracer completely from scratch with zero third-party libraries. It is called Luz, and they coded almost the entire project without any AI assistance. It features Monte Carlo path tracing, global illumination, atmospheric scattering, and even a custom Blender exporter. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/themartiano/luz
